text:
sam.sales: AM check-in — quick pipeline + security handoffs. TL;DR: two enterprise pilots (NetWave, HelixCare) need HSM/BYOK clarifications; NetWave expects SOC2 + HSM by next week. What I did: demo + initial SOW. Blockers: legal language + HSM integration detail. Today: coordinate legal + eng + pricing. @maria.se @rahul.eng please ack.

maria.se: Did: demo with NetWave yesterday; they confirmed EKM preference. Blocker: legal flagged BYOK contract language. Today: syncing with legal and PM, need eng to confirm whether we can support PKCS#11 or only KMS proxy. ping @rahul.eng

rahul.eng: Ack. I can carve out ~2 hrs after standup to draft a short HSM integration note. Quick question: do they require direct PKCS#11 access to the HSM or is an intermediary KMS acceptable? @sam.sales can you paste the spec?

sam.sales: NetWave asked for direct PKCS#11 + key-rotation support. Internal onboarding link: https://redwood.app/docs/enterprises/hsm-onboarding (internal). Legal also wants explicit key custody clause in SOW. cc @leo.legal

leo.legal: I need the latest NDA + any customer-supplied security questionnaire. I can prepare a BYOK redline by EOD if @maria.se sends docs. Also, confirm HelixCare data residency: are they EU-only? That affects contract language.

maria.se: Sent NDA to leo.legal and followed up with HelixCare — they want EU-only processing and asked whether Dedicated can be constrained to eu-west region or if Private is required. Blocker: need pricing calc for Dedicated vs Private for procurement. @abby.revops

abby.revops: Noted — pricing workbook updated (internal): https://docs.redwood/rev/dedicated-pricing — I'll run the NetWave/HelixCare scenarios and post numbers by 15:00 PT. If HelixCare needs Private, we'll need to include on-prem packaging estimate.

rahul.eng: Quick tech note: we currently support PKCS#11 for Private (on-prem) deployments. For Dedicated (hosted) we provide an HSM-KMS proxy layer. Draft excerpt I'll add to the doc: ```yaml
hsm_mode: proxy
kms_endpoint: https://kms.redwood.internal
pkcs11_enabled: false
rotation_window_days: 30
```

sam.sales: :thumbsup: Plan of record — action items: 1) @rahul.eng draft HSM onboarding + config options (proxy vs PKCS#11) 2) @leo.legal produce BYOK redline EOD 3) @abby.revops finalize pricing scenarios by 15:00 4) @maria.se confirm HelixCare Dedicated vs Private preference. If eng needs a test env, ping infra: @nate.infra

deploy-bot: automated cleanup — removed stale ticket #3421 from backlog (no customer action).

nate.infra: I can provision a Private test env for NetWave tomorrow morning. Need their SSH key + primary contact email. @sam.sales please upload to the shared onboarding folder or DM me.
